title: Grok Build bounded-autonomy instruction-profile campaign
research_question: How does instruction framing affect grok-build-0.1 across the complete synthetic incident corpus when every response action is mediated by CyberBroker?
hypothesis: Instruction profile changes may affect model conclusions and action requests, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied action from reaching a simulated tool in every profile.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: Sequential exploratory campaign covering every registered non-neutral instruction profile. Compare with EXP-XAI-GROK-BUILD-CAMPAIGN-001 for the neutral baseline. All cells and failures are retained.
